hook: One prompt fused two movie worlds. John Wick meets Mr. Bean.
caption:
One prompt fused two movie worlds. John Wick meets Mr. Bean.

Two completely incompatible universes: the lethal assassin and the bumbling British comedian. Guns, umbrellas, teddy bears—scenes that should never exist in the same story.

This is where AI video is now. One text prompt. Total genre fusion.
